cn_steps: `EpicGamesTemporary` 位于 `Plugins/Verse/EpicGamesTemporary`，是没有官方描述的 Verse 临时模块。先打开它的 `EpicGamesTemporary.uplugin` 和模块源码，搞清楚当前到底放了哪些设备/编译代码，再决定是否碰它。
在 `编辑 > 插件` 启用后重启，确认它在 Verse 会话里是否登记了设备或编译步骤；看不到任何可见入口是正常的，它通常是内部占位实现。
把它当只读参考：读实现可以，但不要在你自己的 Verse 项目或 C++ 游戏模块里对 `EpicGamesTemporary` 建立长期依赖。
需要复用其中逻辑时，把相关源码复制进你自己的 Verse 工程或插件，而不是直接链接这个临时模块。
升级引擎后重新核对：临时模块最可能被改名或删除，打包前在 `编辑 > 插件` 与 `Build.cs` 里确认没有残留引用，避免缺模块链接失败。
en_steps: `EpicGamesTemporary` lives under `Plugins/Verse/EpicGamesTemporary` and has no official description. Open its `EpicGamesTemporary.uplugin` and module source first to see what Verse device/compile code it actually holds before touching it.

Enable it under `Edit > Plugins` and restart, then check whether it registers any Verse device or compile step in the session. No visible entry point is normal — it is usually an internal placeholder.
Treat it as read-only reference: reading the implementation is fine, but do not build a long-term dependency on `EpicGamesTemporary` from your Verse project or C++ game module.
If you want the logic, copy the relevant source into your own Verse project or plugin instead of linking this temporary module directly.

Re-check after an engine upgrade: temporary modules are the first to be renamed or removed. Before packaging, confirm in `Edit > Plugins` and your `Build.cs` that no stale reference remains, or the link will fail.
note_cn: Verse 临时占位模块，没有公开 API 契约；当作只读样例，别做运行时依赖。
note_en: A temporary Verse placeholder with no public API contract. Treat it as read-only sample code, not a runtime dependency.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `Evaluation Notifies`（模块 `EvaluationNotifiesRuntime` + `EvaluationNotifiesEditor`），它的用途是给动画通知附带动画评估时间码（animation evaluation time code）。
打开一个骨架网格体的动画序列，在 `Notifies` 轨道上右键新建基于该插件的通知，而不是普通 `AnimNotify`；它会让通知携带评估侧的时间码。
在动画蓝图的 `AnimNotify` 事件里读取通知带出的时间码，用它对齐口型、脚步或音效的评估时刻。
在 Sequencer 里采样同一段动画，对比通知触发点与播放头/评估帧是否一致，验证 Experimental 行为是否符合预期。
C++ 侧 include `EvaluationNotifiesRuntime` 的 Public 头里的通知类，重写 `Notify` 回调读取时间码；游戏 `Build.cs` 只加 `EvaluationNotifiesRuntime`。
`EvaluationNotifiesEditor` 只进 `*Editor.Build.cs`。Experimental 接口可能随夜构建变化，先在空关卡验证再接正式动画。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Evaluation Notifies` (modules `EvaluationNotifiesRuntime` + `EvaluationNotifiesEditor`). Its job is animation notifies that carry an animation evaluation time code.
Open a skeletal mesh's animation sequence and right-click the `Notifies` track to add a notify based on this plugin, not a plain `AnimNotify` — this one attaches the evaluation-side time code.
In the AnimBP `AnimNotify` event, read the time code the notify carries and use it to align lip sync, footfalls, or audio at the exact evaluated moment.
In Sequencer, sample the same animation and compare the notify firing point against the playhead/evaluated frame to verify the Experimental behavior.
In C++, include the notify class from `EvaluationNotifiesRuntime` Public headers and override the `Notify` callback to read the time code. Game `Build.cs` adds only `EvaluationNotifiesRuntime`.
Keep `EvaluationNotifiesEditor` in `*Editor.Build.cs` only. Experimental — the contract can change on nightlies, so validate in an empty map before wiring real animations.
note_cn: 关键在通知携带的评估时间码，而不是普通 AnimNotify 的触发；放在 Experimental，慎用于正式项目。
note_en: The point is the evaluation time code the notify carries, not a plain AnimNotify trigger. Experimental — be careful in shipping projects.

cn_steps: `ExampleDeviceProfileSelector` 是引擎里 `IDeviceProfileSelector` 接口的参考实现。先在 `Plugins/Runtime/ExampleDeviceProfileSelector` 下读它的 `.cpp`，看它如何按硬件、分辨率、GPU 等条件匹配设备配置。
启用插件后，在 `Config/DefaultEngine.ini` 的 `[/Script/Engine.Engine]` 把 `DeviceProfileSelectorModule` 指向示例模块名，观察它如何为当前硬件挑中一个 profile。
把这个示例当模板：复制它的类，在 `GetDeviceProfileName` 一类的决策函数里换成你自己设备（机型、SoC、显存）的判定逻辑。
在 `Window > Developer Tools > Device Profiles` 里对照当前生效的 profile，确认选择结果和你写死的规则一致。
用不同机型/DPI 的构建，或命令行 `-deviceprofile=` 强制切换，验证选择器返回的是预期 profile 而不是回退到默认。
要自己实现时只需实现 `IDeviceProfileSelectorModule` 并注册为插件模块，不必依赖示例模块本体；示例仅作学习与拷贝来源。
en_steps: `ExampleDeviceProfileSelector` is the engine's reference implementation of `IDeviceProfileSelector`. Open its `.cpp` under `Plugins/Runtime/ExampleDeviceProfileSelector` and read how it matches a device profile by hardware, resolution, GPU, etc.
Enable it, then in `Config/DefaultEngine.ini` under `[/Script/Engine.Engine]` point `DeviceProfileSelectorModule` at the example module and watch how it picks a profile for the current hardware.
Use the example as a template: copy its class and replace the decision function (e.g. `GetDeviceProfileName`) with your own rules for device model, SoC, or VRAM.
In `Window > Developer Tools > Device Profiles`, compare against the profile that actually becomes active to confirm the selection matches your hard-coded rules.
Test with builds for different devices/DPI, or force `-deviceprofile=` on the command line, and verify the selector returns the expected profile instead of falling back to default.
To ship your own, just implement `IDeviceProfileSelectorModule` and register it as a plugin module — you do not depend on the example itself; it is only a learning/copy source.
note_cn: 它只是接口参考实现，真正用途是照它写出自己的「按硬件选设备配置」模块。
note_en: It is only a reference implementation; the real use is copying it to write your own hardware-based device-profile selection module.

cn_steps: `ExampleCharacterFXEditor` 是基于 `BaseCharacterFXEditor` 基类的示例资产编辑器。先读它的模块源码，理解如何从基类派生出一个自定义 asset editor。
启用后在编辑器里打开它注册的示例资产/工具入口，观察自定的 Toolkit 面板、视口与细节面板是怎么拼起来的。
把它的 `FExampleCharacterFXEditor` 结构当模板：复制骨架，在你自己的 `StartupModule` 里注册 asset editor 与 `AssetTypeActions`。
在 `Tools` 菜单看到示例入口后，对示例资产执行一次编辑，确认 tool mode、视口交互与细节面板属性联动正常。
真正做自己的 CharacterFX 编辑器时继承 `BaseCharacterFXEditor` 基类，而不是修改示例本体，避免和 Experimental 版本冲突。
它注册在 `*Editor` 模块，只用于编辑器侧；不要把 `ExampleCharacterFXEditor` 链接进 Game target。
en_steps: `ExampleCharacterFXEditor` is a sample asset editor built on the `BaseCharacterFXEditor` base classes. Read its module source to see how a custom asset editor is derived from the base.
Enable it, then open the sample asset/tool entry it registers in the editor and study how its Toolkit panels, viewport, and details panel are assembled.
Treat its `FExampleCharacterFXEditor` as a template: copy the skeleton and register your own asset editor and `AssetTypeActions` in your `StartupModule`.
With the sample entry visible under the `Tools` menu, edit a sample asset once and confirm tool mode, viewport interaction, and details-property binding all stay in sync.
To build your own CharacterFX editor, subclass `BaseCharacterFXEditor` rather than modifying the example itself, so Experimental changes do not collide with your code.
It registers in an `*Editor` module and is editor-only; never link `ExampleCharacterFXEditor` into a Game target.
note_cn: 示例源码，教你用 `BaseCharacterFXEditor` 搭自定义资产编辑器；生产时继承基类而非改示例。
note_en: Sample source teaching you to build a custom asset editor on `BaseCharacterFXEditor`. For production, subclass the base instead of editing the sample.

cn_steps: 这是 CQTest 框架的实验测试插件（模块 `CQTestExperimentalTests`）。启用后到源码里找该模块，看它如何用 `TEST_CLASS`、`TEST_METHOD` 等 CQTest 宏组织用例。
打开 `Session Frontend > Automation`（新版为 `Tools > Test Automation`），用过滤器筛出 CQTest 前缀的实验测试并运行。
命令行或 CI 里用 `-ExecCmds="Automation RunTests CQTest"` 批量跑，把结果并入回归流水线。
把它当 CQTest 写法参考：复制其中的 `TEST_CLASS` / `TEST_METHOD` 结构，给你自己的代码质量检查写自动化测试。
若测试因 Experimental 接口变动而失败，对照当前引擎版本更新断言，不要为了变绿而删掉用例。
这类测试模块只服务开发流程，默认不参与游戏运行；打包时不必也不应作为运行时依赖。
en_steps: This is the CQTest framework's experimental test plugin (module `CQTestExperimentalTests`). Enable it, then find the module in source to see how it organizes cases with `TEST_CLASS`, `TEST_METHOD`, and other CQTest macros.
Open `Session Frontend > Automation` (or `Tools > Test Automation`), filter for the CQTest-prefixed experimental tests, and run them.
From the command line or CI, batch-run with `-ExecCmds="Automation RunTests CQTest"` and fold the results into your regression pipeline.
Use it as a CQTest style reference: copy the `TEST_CLASS` / `TEST_METHOD` structure to write automation tests for your own code-quality checks.
If a test fails because an Experimental interface changed, update the assertion to the current engine version — do not delete cases just to make it green.
These test modules serve the development workflow only and are not part of the game runtime; do not make them a runtime dependency when packaging.
note_cn: CQTest 实验用例，重点是学它的宏写法与在 Automation 里跑，不是拿来运行时用。
note_en: Experimental CQTest cases — the value is learning its macro style and running via Automation, not shipping it.

cn_steps: 启用 `Experimental Mesh Modeling Toolset`（模块 `MeshModelingToolsExp` 等，基于 Interactive Tools Framework），然后在编辑器模式下拉里切到 `Modeling`。
在 `Modeling` 模式工具面板中，用这套实验工具对选中的静态网格体做挤出、倒角、布尔、雕刻等网格编辑。
挑一个实验工具，改参数后 `Accept` 提交、`Cancel` 回退，反复确认网格结果符合预期。
若走 AI 助手/自动化，`MeshModelingToolsExp` 暴露只读/只写工具，可让助手对当前选中网格执行建模操作。
把结果保存成新的静态网格体资产，或直接在 PCG/关卡里复用。
C++ 依赖只加运行时模块 `MeshModelingToolsExp`、`GeometryProcessingAdapters`、`ModelingUI`；`MeshModelingToolsEditorOnlyExp`、`ModelingEditorUI` 只进 `*Editor.Build.cs`。
Experimental 工具行为可能随夜构建变化，正式资产制作前先在测试关卡验证结果再落地。
en_steps: Enable `Experimental Mesh Modeling Toolset` (modules like `MeshModelingToolsExp`, built on the Interactive Tools Framework), then switch the editor mode dropdown to `Modeling`.
In the `Modeling` mode tool panel, use this experimental set to extrude, bevel, boolean, and sculpt the selected static mesh.
Pick an experimental tool, tweak parameters, then `Accept` to commit or `Cancel` to revert, repeatedly confirming the mesh result.
For the AI assistant or automation path, `MeshModelingToolsExp` exposes read/write tools so the assistant can drive modeling on the current selection.
Save the result as a new static mesh asset, or reuse it directly in PCG/levels.
C++ dependencies: runtime modules `MeshModelingToolsExp`, `GeometryProcessingAdapters`, `ModelingUI` only; `MeshModelingToolsEditorOnlyExp`, `ModelingEditorUI` go only in `*Editor.Build.cs`.
Experimental behavior can change on nightlies — validate results in a test level before committing production assets.
note_cn: 在 Modeling 模式里用的是实验建模工具；工具名与行为会变，AI/自动化通过 `MeshModelingToolsExp` 的读写工具驱动。
note_en: You use these inside Modeling mode; tool names/behavior shift, and AI/automation drives them via the read/write tools in `MeshModelingToolsExp`.

cn_steps: 启用前先改网络配置：在 `Config/DefaultEngine.ini` 的 `[/Script/Engine.Engine]` 里，把原有 `NetDriverDefinitions` 全部禁用或删除，才能用 `WebSocketNetDriver`，否则会和 UDP 驱动冲突。
新增一条指向 `WebSocketNetDriver` 的 `NetDriverDefinitions`，把默认驱动关到只剩它。
在 `PacketHandlerComponents` 里禁用 HTML5/WebSocket 不支持的组件（如 `SteamAuthComponentModuleInterface`），否则握手阶段会失败。
服务端与客户端都要启用 `WebSocketNetworking`，用 `-log` 启动，确认连接日志里使用的是 `WebSocketNetDriver` 而非默认驱动。
目标为 HTML5/浏览器时，按对应平台打包，确认运行时加载的 NetDriver 名为 `WebSocketNetDriver`。
握手失败时先查是否仍有残留的其他 `NetDriverDefinitions` 或未禁用的 `PacketHandler`，这是最常见原因。
Experimental：正式上线前用真实延迟/负载验证稳定性与吞吐。
en_steps: Change networking config first: in `Config/DefaultEngine.ini` under `[/Script/Engine.Engine]`, disable or remove all existing `NetDriverDefinitions`, otherwise `WebSocketNetDriver` conflicts with the UDP driver.
Add one `NetDriverDefinitions` entry pointing to `WebSocketNetDriver`, leaving it as the only default driver.
Disable `PacketHandlerComponents` that HTML5/WebSocket cannot support (e.g. `SteamAuthComponentModuleInterface`), or the handshake will fail.
Enable `WebSocketNetworking` on both client and server, launch with `-log`, and confirm the connection log shows `WebSocketNetDriver`, not the default driver.
For HTML5/browser targets, package for that platform and confirm the runtime-loaded NetDriver is `WebSocketNetDriver`.
When the handshake fails, first check for leftover other `NetDriverDefinitions` or an un-disabled `PacketHandler` — that is the most common cause.
Experimental: validate stability and throughput with realistic latency/load before going live.
note_cn: 核心是清空其它 NetDriver 并禁用不兼容 PacketHandler；否则 WebSocket 驱动根本接管不了连接。
note_en: The key is clearing other NetDrivers and disabling incompatible PacketHandlers; otherwise the WebSocket driver never takes over the connection.

cn_steps: 启用 `ExternalGPUStatistics`（运行时模块 `ExternalGPUStatistics`）后，在 NVIDIA/AMD/Intel 显卡的机器上运行编辑器或打包游戏。
用控制台 `stat GPU` / `stat RHI` 做基准，再用该插件拉取驱动层更细的 GPU 占用（各引擎、队列与 pass 的耗时）。
结合外部 GPU 厂商 profiler（如 Nsight、Radeon GPU Profiler）或启动参数导出，交叉比对插件统计与驱动数据。
分别在 DX12、Vulkan 等 RHI 下各跑一遍，确认统计口径一致再采信数值。
做性能对比时固定场景与摄像机，一次只改一个变量，避免多变量噪声掩盖真实差异。
它是运行时插件可进包，但只建议在 profiling 构建里开启，正式发布包关掉以减少额外开销。
en_steps: Enable `ExternalGPUStatistics` (runtime module `ExternalGPUStatistics`), then run the editor or a packaged game on an NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPU machine.
Take a baseline with `stat GPU` / `stat RHI`, then use the plugin to pull finer driver-level GPU usage (per-engine, per-queue, per-pass timings).
Cross-check the plugin numbers against an external vendor profiler (Nsight, Radeon GPU Profiler) or an exported run, to validate what the plugin reports.
Run once each under DX12, Vulkan, etc., and confirm the metrics line up before trusting the numbers.
For perf comparisons, fix the scene and camera and change one variable at a time so multi-variable noise does not mask the real difference.
It is a runtime plugin that can ship, but enable it only in profiling builds and turn it off in release packages to avoid the extra overhead.
note_cn: 用于拿 GPU 驱动层更细的占用，需与厂商 profiler 交叉验证；建议仅在 profiling 构建开启。
note_en: Gets finer driver-level GPU usage; cross-check with vendor profilers and enable it only in profiling builds.

cn_steps: 启用 `Fab` 插件并重启，在编辑器主工具栏或 `Window` 菜单打开 Fab 面板。
在 Fab 面板登录 Epic 账号，搜索或浏览要用的资产、插件与工具。
获取/购买后，在面板里对该资产点 `Add to Project`，把它直接导入当前项目的内容浏览器。
导入后在内容浏览器定位新生成的资产目录，按需迁移到你项目自己的 `Content` 结构里整理。
若安装的是插件类产品，再到 `编辑 > 插件` 确认已启用并重启，使其模块生效。
团队协作时把导入资产纳入版本管理，留意 Fab 资产的授权条款与体积，避免把大文件塞进仓库。
en_steps: Enable the `Fab` plugin and restart, then open the Fab panel from the editor main toolbar or the `Window` menu.
Log in with your Epic account in the Fab panel and search or browse for the assets, plugins, and tools you need.
After acquiring/purchasing, click `Add to Project` on the asset in the panel to import it directly into the current project's Content Browser.
Locate the newly created asset folder in the Content Browser and move things into your project's own `Content` structure as needed.
If the product is a plugin, confirm it under `Edit > Plugins` and restart so its modules take effect.
For team work, put imported assets under version control, watch Fab licensing terms, and check size so you do not commit huge files.
note_cn: Fab 面板内登录、获取资产后 `Add to Project` 直接导入；插件类产品还要去插件面板启用。
note_en: Log in and acquire assets in the Fab panel, then `Add to Project` to import; plugin products still need enabling in the Plugins panel.

cn_steps: `FabToolset` 是给编辑器内 AI 助手用的工具集，启用后助手才有权限列出你 Fab 账号拥有的资产并安装。
在带 AI 助手的编辑器会话里，让助手「列出我 Fab 上拥有的资产」，确认它返回的是你账号下的资产清单。
选定某个资产后，让助手「把这个资产安装到当前编辑器」，观察它下载并导入到内容浏览器。
安装完成后在内容浏览器核对资产是否真正落地；若是插件类资产，再到 `编辑 > 插件` 启用并重启。
因为它是 Experimental 工具，先在测试项目里跑通整条安装链路，再用于正式项目。
它只服务编辑器自动化流程，打包游戏时不必把它当作运行时依赖。
en_steps: `FabToolset` is a toolset for the in-editor AI assistant. Enable it so the assistant is allowed to list the assets your Fab account owns and install them.
In an editor session with the AI assistant, ask it to list the assets you own on Fab and confirm it returns your account's asset list.
Pick an asset and ask the assistant to install it into the running editor, then watch it download and import into the Content Browser.
After installation, verify the asset actually landed in the Content Browser; if it is a plugin, enable it under `Edit > Plugins` and restart.
Because it is an Experimental tool, run the full install path in a test project before using it on a production project.
It serves editor automation only; you do not need it as a runtime dependency when packaging the game.
note_cn: 为 AI 助手开后门去列/装 Fab 资产；Experimental，先在测试项目验证安装链路。
note_en: Grants the AI assistant the ability to list/install Fab assets. Experimental — validate the install path in a test project first.

cn_steps: 启用 `FacialAnimation` 插件（模块 `FacialAnimation` + `FacialAnimationEditor`）并重启，确认面部动画导入器与编辑面板就绪。
准备带面部曲线表（curve table）的 FBX 及对应音频，核对曲线名与目标骨架/曲线命名一致。
用批量导入器把 FBX 里的面部动画曲线表导入，并映射到目标音频 `SoundWave`；它的本职就是把曲线表导入声波。
在导入对话框里检查曲线到音频的对应关系与采样帧率，确认后再批量执行导入。
导入后打开生成的 `SoundWave` / 曲线表，在 Sequencer 或动画蓝图里播放，验证口型与音频同步。
出现错位时回到映射步骤修正起止帧与曲线对位，再重新导入，不要手改已生成资产。
它是编辑器侧制作工具，只在管线里用，不进游戏运行时；游戏 `Build.cs` 只加 `FacialAnimation` 运行时模块。
en_steps: Enable the `FacialAnimation` plugin (modules `FacialAnimation` + `FacialAnimationEditor`) and restart, confirming the facial importer and edit panel are ready.
Prepare an FBX with facial curve tables plus the matching audio, and verify the curve names line up with your target skeleton/curve naming.
Use the bulk importer to import the facial animation curve tables from the FBX and map them onto the target audio `SoundWave` — importing curve tables into sound waves is its core job.
In the import dialog, check the curve-to-audio mapping and sample rate, then run the bulk import.
Open the generated `SoundWave` / curve table and play it in Sequencer or the AnimBP to verify lip sync lines up with the audio.
If it desyncs, go back to the mapping step and fix start/end frames and curve alignment, then re-import — do not hand-edit generated assets.
It is an editor-side authoring tool for the pipeline, not a runtime dependency; game `Build.cs` adds only the `FacialAnimation` runtime module.
note_cn: 把 FBX 面部曲线表批量导入并映射进 `SoundWave`；出错回映射步骤重导，别手改产物。
note_en: Bulk-imports FBX facial curve tables and maps them into `SoundWave`; on desync, fix the mapping and re-import instead of editing outputs.

cn_steps: 先安装 FastBuild 并配好分布式编译环境（broker/worker、`FASTBUILD_BROKER` 等环境变量），确保 broker 可被访问。
启用 `FastBuildController` 插件，让着色器编译可以走 FastBuild 的分布式后端。
在项目设置或 `DefaultEngine.ini` 里打开着色器编译分发，指定 broker 与 worker 列表（或多个 worker 节点）。
启动若干 FastBuild worker 节点，回到编辑器触发着色器编译（改材质、加光源或 `RecompileShaders`）。
在日志里搜 FastBuild/Broker 相关行，确认编译任务被分发到 worker，而不是本机串行编译。
对比开启前后的着色器编译耗时验证分发生效；节点掉线时先查 broker 连通性与防火墙。
en_steps: Install FastBuild and set up distributed compilation (broker/workers, `FASTBUILD_BROKER` and related env vars) so the broker is reachable.
Enable the `FastBuildController` plugin so shader compilation can use FastBuild's distributed backend.
In project settings or `DefaultEngine.ini`, turn on shader compile distribution and specify the broker plus worker list (or multiple worker nodes).
Start some FastBuild worker nodes, then back in the editor trigger a shader compile (change a material, add a light, or run `RecompileShaders`).
Search the log for FastBuild/Broker lines to confirm tasks are dispatched to workers rather than compiled serially locally.
Compare shader-compile time before and after to confirm distribution works; if a node drops, check broker reachability and firewall first.
note_cn: 本质是着色器编译的分发，不是输入控制器；要先把 broker/worker 环境配好才能看到分发。
note_en: It is shader-compile distribution, not an input controller; set up the broker/worker environment first to see tasks dispatch.

cn_steps: 启用 `FastGeoStreaming`（模块 `FastGeoStreaming` + `FastGeoStreamingEditor`），它的用途是把 World Partition 分区世界的几何提取并转换，以优化流式加载性能。
打开一个已启用 World Partition 的关卡，确认单元格（cell）已生成、世界分区数据完整。
运行该插件提供的提取/转换流程，把分区世界几何转成更适合流式加载的数据。
转换后检查生成数据是否随 cell 正确加载与卸载，而非一次性全量加载。
用 `stat streaming` 与 World Partition 视图对比转换前后的流式表现，确认优化生效。
C++ 运行时代码只依赖 `FastGeoStreaming`；编辑器流程模块 `FastGeoStreamingEditor` 只进 `*Editor.Build.cs`。
Experimental：先在副本关卡上验证转换不破坏几何，再用于正式世界。
en_steps: Enable `FastGeoStreaming` (modules `FastGeoStreaming` + `FastGeoStreamingEditor`). Its job is extracting and converting a World Partition world's geometry to optimize streaming performance.
Open a level already using World Partition and confirm cells are generated and the partition data is complete.
Run the plugin's extraction/conversion flow to convert the partitioned world geometry into streaming-friendly data.
After conversion, verify the generated data loads and unloads with its cells correctly rather than loading all at once.
Compare streaming behavior before and after using `stat streaming` and the World Partition view to confirm the optimization works.
Runtime C++ depends only on `FastGeoStreaming`; the editor flow module `FastGeoStreamingEditor` goes only in `*Editor.Build.cs`.
Experimental: validate on a duplicated level that conversion does not break geometry before applying it to the real world.
note_cn: 针对 World Partition 几何做提取转换优化流式；先副本关卡验证再上正式世界。
note_en: Extracts/converts World Partition geometry to optimize streaming; validate on a duplicated level before applying to the real world.

cn_steps: 启用 `FbxAutomationTestBuilder`（模块 `FbxAutomationTestBuilder`，测试类），它用于对 FBX 导入管线做自动化测试。
打开 `Session Frontend > Automation`（或 `Tools > Test Automation`），筛出该插件构建的 FBX 自动化用例。
运行用例，观察它如何用测试数据构建 FBX 导入场景，并对导入结果（网格、材质、骨骼）做断言。
把它当测试脚手架模板：复用其 builder 结构，为你自己的导入器写自动化导入测试。
在命令行/CI 里用 `-ExecCmds="Automation RunTests Fbx"` 批量跑，把 FBX 导入回归并入流水线。
它是开发测试模块，只在开发流程里用，不参与游戏运行，不要作为运行时依赖打包。
en_steps: Enable `FbxAutomationTestBuilder` (module `FbxAutomationTestBuilder`, a test plugin). It automates tests for the FBX import pipeline.
Open `Session Frontend > Automation` (or `Tools > Test Automation`) and filter for the FBX automation cases this plugin builds.
Run the cases and study how it constructs an FBX import scenario from test data and asserts on the result (meshes, materials, skeletons).
Use it as a test scaffolding template: reuse its builder structure to write automated import tests for your own importer.
Batch-run from the command line or CI with `-ExecCmds="Automation RunTests Fbx"` and fold FBX-import regression into the pipeline.
It is a development test module for the dev workflow only and is not part of the game runtime; do not ship it as a runtime dependency.
note_cn: FBX 导入的自动化测试脚手架，学它在 Automation 里构建导入场景并断言；纯开发用途。
note_en: An automation-test scaffold for FBX import — learn to build import scenarios and assert in Automation; dev-only.

cn_steps: 启用 `FieldNotificationTrace`（模块 `FieldNotificationTrace` + `FieldNotificationTraceEditor`），它给字段通知（Field Notify）对象增加 trace 支持，配合 Unreal Insights 分析。
启动带 trace 的会话，命令行加对应 channel（如 `-trace=default,fieldnotification` 或 `-trace=fieldnotification`），让字段通知被记录。
在游戏或 UMG 里触发字段通知：例如 `FieldNotify` 广播、MVVM 视图模型属性变更引发的通知刷新。
停止 trace 后用 Unreal Insights 打开，在对应 track 里查看字段通知的触发时机、频率与耗时。
用 trace 定位 UMG/视图模型里频繁或异常的通知刷新，据此减少不必要的通知与重绘。
C++ 运行时代码只依赖 `FieldNotificationTrace`；编辑器分析模块 `FieldNotificationTraceEditor` 只进 `*Editor.Build.cs`。
它服务编辑器/开发排障，正式包不必也不应开启 trace 通道。
en_steps: Enable `FieldNotificationTrace` (modules `FieldNotificationTrace` + `FieldNotificationTraceEditor`). It adds trace support for field notification (Field Notify) objects, meant for Unreal Insights analysis.
Start a traced session with the matching channel (e.g. `-trace=default,fieldnotification` or `-trace=fieldnotification`) so field notifications get recorded.
Trigger field notifications in-game or in UMG — for example a `FieldNotify` broadcast, or the notification refresh caused by a MVVM view-model property change.
Stop the trace and open it in Unreal Insights, then inspect the relevant track for field-notification trigger timing, frequency, and cost.
Use the trace to find frequent or anomalous notification refreshes in UMG/view models, then cut unneeded notifications and repaints.
Runtime C++ depends only on `FieldNotificationTrace`; the editor analysis module `FieldNotificationTraceEditor` goes only in `*Editor.Build.cs`.
It serves editor/developer troubleshooting; release builds should not enable the trace channel.
note_cn: 抓 FieldNotify 的 trace，在 Insights 里看触发时机/频率；排 UMG/MVVM 过度通知时用。
note_en: Captures FieldNotify traces to inspect trigger timing/frequency in Insights; use it to debug UMG/MVVM over-notification.
